description: This file contains C source code implementing DRM platform initialization and deinitialization functions, as well as a proxy function for decrypting opaque content and handling secure pointer conversion in the PlayReady DRM system.

methods.name: DRM_RESULT drm_playready_platform_init()
methods.description: Initializes the DRM platform library, returns success or failure code.

methods.name: DRM_RESULT drm_playready_platform_deinit()
methods.description: Deinitializes the DRM platform library, returns success or failure code.

methods.description: Proxy function that calls the DRM decrypt method, then converts a secure pointer to a handle, returning success or failure status.
